title: TV clip of a UFO turning away from a beam in space

tellings.quote: On TV. Uh there's a a clip that they show on TV every now and then of this UFO that's coming in and a beam goes like that and the thing turns around and leaves

plain: A UFO in space, filmed as it came in, turned around and left when a beam shot toward it, according to a clip that a former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan says he has seen. Buchanan tells Michels it is a clip "they show on TV every now and then," in which "a beam goes like that and the thing turns around and leaves." To him it suggests the craft reacted to being fired upon.
